name: Ron Ben-Yizhak
biography: Ron Ben-Yizhak is a security researcher at Deep Instinct. He is responsible for research of malware campaigns, attack surfaces and vectors and evasion techniques. His findings are used for developing new analysis, detection, and mitigation capabilities. Ron joined Deep Instinct in 2019 after serving as a security researcher and forensics specialist in one of the IDF's elite cyber units.
